title: confed version result
description: Everything a caller needs to decide whether the confed it found is the one it expects: the three versions that make up the compatibility contract, and the release notes compiled into the binary.

version.description: The binary's release, the same string as confed.version in the envelope.

json_schema.description: Envelope schema this build produces; bumped only for a breaking change.

state_schema.description: Highest .state.db schema this build understands. A newer database is refused rather than migrated downward.

changelog.description: Release notes, newest first. Empty unless --changelog was given: with it, the section for this build, or with --since, every release after that version.

version.description: The release, or "Unreleased" for changes not yet in one.

date.description: Release date as the changelog records it, usually YYYY-MM-DD. Absent for an unreleased section.

notes.description: The section body as Markdown, heading excluded.
